description: Creation of two additional openings to Stable Cottages in order to improve accessibility to the internal spaces and provide a shopfront to proposed retail space. Installation of glazing to the west loggia to increase retail space
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( Syon Estate Site Location Plan; 638f-DJA-DR-A-007; 638f-DJA-DR-A-005; 638f-DJA-DR-A-004; 638f-DJA-DR-A-003; 638f-DJA-DR-A-002 and Design & Access, Heritage and Planning Statements dated August 2022. Received: 02 September 2022. 
638f-DJA-DR-A-008 Rev PO2; 638f-DJA-SK-A-30 Rev P02 and 638f-DJA-DR-A-006 Rev P02. Received: 17 October 2022 ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.

Condition : 4 - Prior to the installation of any new internal or external lighting, required as part of the proposal, details of such shall be first submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. These details shall be carried out as approved.
